title: NCERT Grade 10 Social Science | Resource Definition
text:
Resource Definition

Key terms: resource, technology, culture

Resources are things available in our environment that can satisfy our needs, provided they are technologically accessible, economically feasible, and culturally acceptable.

metadata.subject: Social Science
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to remember concepts related to Resource Definition in Grade 10 Social Science.

title: NCERT Grade 10 Social Science | Resource Transformation
text:
Resource Transformation

Key terms: nature, technology, institution

Human beings interact with nature through technology and create institutions to transform things available in our environment into resources and use them.

metadata.subject: Social Science
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Resource Transformation in Grade 10 Social Science.

title: NCERT Grade 10 Social Science | Resource Classification
text:
Resource Classification

Key terms: biotic, abiotic, renewable, non-renewable

Resources can be classified based on origin (biotic and abiotic), exhaustibility (renewable and non-renewable), ownership (individual, community, national, and international), and status of development (potential, developed stock, and reserves).

metadata.subject: Social Science
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to apply concepts related to Resource Classification in Grade 10 Social Science.

title: NCERT Grade 10 Social Science | Sustainable Development
text:
Sustainable Development

Key terms: sustainable development, environment, future generations

Sustainable development means development should take place without damaging the environment, and development in the present should not compromise the needs of future generations.

metadata.subject: Social Science
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Sustainable Development in Grade 10 Social Science.

title: NCERT Grade 10 Social Science | Resource Planning
text:
Resource Planning

Key terms: planning, judicious use, resource availability

Planning is essential for the judicious use of resources, especially in a country like India with enormous diversity in resource availability.

metadata.subject: Social Science
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to apply concepts related to Resource Planning in Grade 10 Social Science.

title: NCERT Grade 10 Social Science | Land Resources
text:
Land Resources

Key terms: land, natural resource, vegetation, wildlife

Land is a natural resource of utmost importance that supports natural vegetation, wildlife, human life, economic activities, transport, and communication systems.

metadata.subject: Social Science
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to remember concepts related to Land Resources in Grade 10 Social Science.

title: NCERT Grade 10 Social Science | Land Use Pattern
text:
Land Use Pattern

Key terms: land use, physical factors, human factors

The use of land is determined by both physical factors like topography, climate, and soil types, as well as human factors such as population density, technological capability, and culture.

metadata.subject: Social Science
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Land Use Pattern in Grade 10 Social Science.

title: NCERT Grade 10 Social Science | Land Degradation
text:
Land Degradation

Key terms: land degradation, deforestation, overgrazing, mining

Land degradation is caused by continuous use of land over a long period without appropriate conservation measures, as well as human activities like deforestation, overgrazing, mining, and industrial effluents.

metadata.subject: Social Science
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to analyze concepts related to Land Degradation in Grade 10 Social Science.

title: NCERT Grade 10 Social Science | Soil Degradation Causes
text:
Soil Degradation Causes

Key terms: water logging, salinity, alkalinity, industrial effluents

Soil degradation occurs due to water logging, increased salinity and alkalinity, dust from mineral processing, and industrial effluents.

metadata.subject: Social Science
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to remember concepts related to Soil Degradation Causes in Grade 10 Social Science.

title: NCERT Grade 10 Social Science | Soil Formation Factors
text:
Soil Formation Factors

Key terms: relief, parent rock, climate, vegetation, natural forces

Soil formation is influenced by relief, parent rock, climate, vegetation, time, and various natural forces like temperature change, water, wind, and glaciers.

metadata.subject: Social Science
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Soil Formation Factors in Grade 10 Social Science.

title: NCERT Grade 10 Social Science | Soil Classification
text:
Soil Classification

Key terms: color, thickness, texture, age, chemical properties, physical properties

Soils in India are classified based on factors like color, thickness, texture, age, chemical, and physical properties.

metadata.subject: Social Science
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to apply concepts related to Soil Classification in Grade 10 Social Science.

title: NCERT Grade 10 Social Science | Alluvial Soils
text:
Alluvial Soils

Key terms: alluvial, fertile, river deposits, sugarcane, paddy, wheat

Alluvial soils are widely spread, fertile, and formed by river deposits. They are ideal for growing crops like sugarcane, paddy, and wheat.

metadata.subject: Social Science
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Alluvial Soils in Grade 10 Social Science.

title: NCERT Grade 10 Social Science | Black Soil
text:
Black Soil

Key terms: black soil, regur soil, cotton, Deccan trap, nutrients

Black soil, also known as regur soil, is black in color, rich in nutrients, and ideal for growing cotton. It is typical of the Deccan trap region.

metadata.subject: Social Science
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to remember concepts related to Black Soil in Grade 10 Social Science.

title: NCERT Grade 10 Social Science | Soil Erosion Causes
text:
Soil Erosion Causes

Key terms: wind, water, glaciers, deforestation, overgrazing

Soil erosion is caused by natural forces like wind, water, and glaciers, as well as human activities like deforestation and overgrazing.

metadata.subject: Social Science
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Soil Erosion Causes in Grade 10 Social Science.

title: NCERT Grade 10 Social Science | Soil Erosion Types
text:
Soil Erosion Types

Key terms: gully erosion, sheet erosion, wind erosion

Soil erosion can occur in various forms such as gully erosion, sheet erosion, and wind erosion.

metadata.subject: Social Science
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to apply concepts related to Soil Erosion Types in Grade 10 Social Science.

title: NCERT Grade 10 Social Science | Soil Conservation Methods
text:
Soil Conservation Methods

Key terms: contour ploughing, terrace farming, strip cropping, shelter belts

Soil conservation methods include contour ploughing, terrace farming, strip cropping, and planting shelter belts of trees.

metadata.subject: Social Science
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to apply concepts related to Soil Conservation Methods in Grade 10 Social Science.

title: NCERT Grade 10 Social Science | Biodiversity and Its Importance
text:
Biodiversity and Its Importance

Key terms: biodiversity, ecosystem services

Biodiversity refers to the variety of life at genetic, species, and ecosystem levels. It's crucial for human lives as it provides food, medicine, and ecosystem services like clean air and water.

metadata.subject: Social Science
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Biodiversity and Its Importance in Grade 10 Social Science.

title: NCERT Grade 10 Social Science | Human Impact on Flora and Fauna
text:
Human Impact on Flora and Fauna

Key terms: deforestation, pollution, hunting

Human activities like deforestation, pollution, and hunting have led to the depletion of flora and fauna. This is mainly due to insensitivity towards the environment.

metadata.subject: Social Science
metadata.topic: Human Impact on Flora and Fauna
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Human Impact on Flora and Fauna in Grade 10 Social Science.

title: NCERT Grade 10 Social Science | Community Conservation Efforts
text:
Community Conservation Efforts

Key terms: Chipko Movement, Joint Forest Management, sacred groves

Communities in India have conserved forests and wildlife through practices like the Chipko Movement, Joint Forest Management, and protecting sacred groves.

metadata.subject: Social Science
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to apply concepts related to Community Conservation Efforts in Grade 10 Social Science.

title: NCERT Grade 10 Social Science | Conservation of Forests and Wildlife in India
text:
Conservation of Forests and Wildlife in India

Key terms: Project Tiger, national parks, wildlife sanctuaries

India has implemented various conservation strategies like Project Tiger, national parks, and wildlife sanctuaries to protect its rich biodiversity.

metadata.subject: Social Science
metadata.topic: Conservation of Forests and Wildlife in India
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to remember concepts related to Conservation of Forests and Wildlife in India in Grade 10 Social Science.

title: NCERT Grade 10 Social Science | Forest Classification in India
text:
Forest Classification in India

Key terms: reserved forests, protected forests, unclassed forests

Indian forests are classified into reserved, protected, and unclassed forests based on their value and protection status.

metadata.subject: Social Science
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Forest Classification in India in Grade 10 Social Science.

title: NCERT Grade 10 Social Science | Nature Worship and Conservation
text:
Nature Worship and Conservation

Key terms: nature worship, sacred groves, wildlife protection

Indian societies have traditional methods of conserving nature through nature worship, revering specific trees, and protecting wildlife.

metadata.subject: Social Science
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to analyze concepts related to Nature Worship and Conservation in Grade 10 Social Science.

title: NCERT Grade 10 Social Science | Involving Communities in Conservation
text:
Involving Communities in Conservation

Key terms: local communities, natural resource management, sustainable conservation

Involving local communities in conservation efforts is crucial for successful and sustainable management of natural resources.

metadata.subject: Social Science
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to evaluate concepts related to Involving Communities in Conservation in Grade 10 Social Science.

title: NCERT Grade 10 Social Science | Water Scarcity Causes
text:
Water Scarcity Causes

Key terms: water scarcity, over-exploitation, unequal access

Water scarcity occurs due to over-exploitation, excessive use, and unequal access to water. It can happen even in areas with ample water resources due to pollution or poor management.

metadata.subject: Social Science
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Water Scarcity Causes in Grade 10 Social Science.

title: NCERT Grade 10 Social Science | Hydrological Cycle
text:
Hydrological Cycle

Key terms: hydrological cycle, precipitation, groundwater

Water moves through a cycle involving precipitation, surface runoff, and groundwater, ensuring water is a renewable resource.

metadata.subject: Social Science
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to remember concepts related to Hydrological Cycle in Grade 10 Social Science.

title: NCERT Grade 10 Social Science | Water Conservation
text:
Water Conservation

Key terms: water conservation, water management

Conserving water involves reducing usage, preventing wastage, and managing resources to ensure availability for all.

metadata.subject: Social Science
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to apply concepts related to Water Conservation in Grade 10 Social Science.

title: NCERT Grade 10 Social Science | Multi-purpose Dams
text:
Multi-purpose Dams

Key terms: multi-purpose dams, environmental impact

Dams are built for various purposes like irrigation, electricity generation, and flood control, but they can also cause environmental issues.

metadata.subject: Social Science
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to analyze concepts related to Multi-purpose Dams in Grade 10 Social Science.

title: NCERT Grade 10 Social Science | Water Harvesting
text:
Water Harvesting

Key terms: water harvesting, rainwater harvesting

Ancient water harvesting systems collected and stored rainwater, groundwater, and river water for various uses, adapting to local ecological conditions.

metadata.subject: Social Science
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to evaluate concepts related to Water Harvesting in Grade 10 Social Science.

title: NCERT Grade 10 Social Science | Traditional Rainwater Harvesting in Rajasthan
text:
Traditional Rainwater Harvesting in Rajasthan

Key terms: rainwater harvesting, tanka, khadin

People in Rajasthan, a semi-arid region, traditionally harvest rainwater using 'tankas' (underground tanks) and 'khadins' (rain-fed storage structures) to store and use water for drinking and agriculture.

metadata.subject: Social Science
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Traditional Rainwater Harvesting in Rajasthan in Grade 10 Social Science.

title: NCERT Grade 10 Social Science | Rooftop Rainwater Harvesting
text:
Rooftop Rainwater Harvesting

Key terms: rooftop, rainwater harvesting, filter, recharge

Rooftop rainwater harvesting involves collecting rainwater from rooftops, filtering it, and storing it for immediate use or recharging underground water sources.

metadata.subject: Social Science
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to apply concepts related to Rooftop Rainwater Harvesting in Grade 10 Social Science.

title: NCERT Grade 10 Social Science | Water Scarcity
text:
Water Scarcity

Key terms: water scarcity, rainfall, population, water pollution

Water scarcity occurs when there is not enough water to meet human and environmental demands. It can be caused by low rainfall, high population, and water pollution.

metadata.subject: Social Science
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Water Scarcity in Grade 10 Social Science.

title: NCERT Grade 10 Social Science | Multi-purpose River Projects
text:
Multi-purpose River Projects

Key terms: multi-purpose, river projects, irrigation, hydropower, flood control

Multi-purpose river projects aim to use river water for multiple purposes like irrigation, hydropower, and flood control. They have advantages and disadvantages, including large-scale displacements and loss of livelihood.

metadata.subject: Social Science
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to analyze concepts related to Multi-purpose River Projects in Grade 10 Social Science.

title: NCERT Grade 10 Social Science | Bamboo Drip Irrigation System
text:
Bamboo Drip Irrigation System

Key terms: bamboo drip irrigation, Meghalaya, bamboo pipes

In Meghalaya, a traditional bamboo drip irrigation system is used to transport water from streams and springs to plants using bamboo pipes.

metadata.subject: Social Science
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Bamboo Drip Irrigation System in Grade 10 Social Science.

title: NCERT Grade 10 Social Science | Water as a Renewable Resource
text:
Water as a Renewable Resource

Key terms: renewable resource, water cycle

Water is a renewable resource because it cycles through the Earth's hydrosphere, atmosphere, and lithosphere, replenishing itself over time.

metadata.subject: Social Science
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Water as a Renewable Resource in Grade 10 Social Science.

title: NCERT Grade 10 Social Science | Modern Adaptations of Traditional Rainwater Harvesting
text:
Modern Adaptations of Traditional Rainwater Harvesting

Key terms: modern adaptations, traditional rainwater harvesting, technology

Modern adaptations of traditional rainwater harvesting methods involve using technology to improve water collection, storage, and usage, such as in Gendathur, Karnataka.

metadata.subject: Social Science
metadata.topic: Modern Adaptations of Traditional Rainwater Harvesting
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to apply concepts related to Modern Adaptations of Traditional Rainwater Harvesting in Grade 10 Social Science.

title: NCERT Grade 10 Social Science | Agricultural Importance of India
text:
Agricultural Importance of India

Key terms: agriculture, food grains, industries, exports

India is an agriculturally important country with two-thirds of its population engaged in agricultural activities. It produces most of the food consumed and also provides raw materials for various industries. Some agricultural products like tea, coffee, and spices are exported.

metadata.subject: Social Science
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to remember concepts related to Agricultural Importance of India in Grade 10 Social Science.

title: NCERT Grade 10 Social Science | Types of Farming in India
text:
Types of Farming in India

Key terms: primitive subsistence farming, intensive subsistence farming, commercial farming

Agriculture in India varies from subsistence to commercial type. The main types of farming systems are primitive subsistence farming, intensive subsistence farming, and commercial farming.

metadata.subject: Social Science
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Types of Farming in India in Grade 10 Social Science.

title: NCERT Grade 10 Social Science | Primitive Subsistence Farming
text:
Primitive Subsistence Farming

Key terms: slash and burn, monsoon, natural fertility

This type of farming is still practised in few pockets of India. It uses primitive tools and family/community labour. Farmers clear a patch of land, produce cereals and other food crops to sustain their family, and then shift to a fresh patch of land when soil fertility decreases.

metadata.subject: Social Science
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to apply concepts related to Primitive Subsistence Farming in Grade 10 Social Science.

title: NCERT Grade 10 Social Science | Intensive Subsistence Farming
text:
Intensive Subsistence Farming

Key terms: labour-intensive, biochemical inputs, irrigation

This type of farming is practised in areas of high population pressure on land. It is labour-intensive, using high doses of biochemical inputs and irrigation for higher production.

metadata.subject: Social Science
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to analyze concepts related to Intensive Subsistence Farming in Grade 10 Social Science.

title: NCERT Grade 10 Social Science | Commercial Farming
text:
Commercial Farming

Key terms: modern inputs, HYV seeds, plantation

This type of farming uses higher doses of modern inputs like HYV seeds, chemical fertilizers, insecticides, and pesticides to obtain higher productivity. Plantation is also a type of commercial farming where a single crop is grown on a large area.

metadata.subject: Social Science
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to evaluate concepts related to Commercial Farming in Grade 10 Social Science.

title: NCERT Grade 10 Social Science | Cropping Seasons in India
text:
Cropping Seasons in India

Key terms: rabi, kharif, zaid

India has three cropping seasons: rabi (winter), kharif (monsoon), and zaid (summer). Different crops are grown in these seasons, such as wheat, rice, and vegetables.

metadata.subject: Social Science
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to create concepts related to Cropping Seasons in India in Grade 10 Social Science.

title: NCERT Grade 10 Social Science | Major Crops in India
text:
Major Crops in India

Key terms: rice, wheat, millets, pulses

India produces a variety of food and non-food crops depending on soil, climate, and cultivation practices. Major crops include rice, wheat, millets, pulses, tea, coffee, sugarcane, oilseeds, cotton, and jute.

metadata.subject: Social Science
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to remember concepts related to Major Crops in India in Grade 10 Social Science.

title: NCERT Grade 10 Social Science | Agricultural Diversification
text:
Agricultural Diversification

Key terms: diversification, fruits, vegetables, spices

India has a diverse range of agricultural products, including tropical and temperate fruits, vegetables, spices, and condiments. It is the second-largest producer of fruits and vegetables in the world.

metadata.subject: Social Science
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Agricultural Diversification in Grade 10 Social Science.

title: NCERT Grade 10 Social Science | India's Fruit and Vegetable Production
text:
India's Fruit and Vegetable Production

Key terms: fruits, vegetables, tropical, temperate

India is the second largest producer of fruits and vegetables in the world. It grows a variety of tropical and temperate fruits like mangoes, bananas, apples, and grapes.

metadata.subject: Social Science
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to remember concepts related to India's Fruit and Vegetable Production in Grade 10 Social Science.

title: NCERT Grade 10 Social Science | Tea Cultivation in India
text:
Tea Cultivation in India

Key terms: tea, cultivation, climate, rainfall, temperature

Tea is cultivated in India, with major production in states like Assam, West Bengal, and Tamil Nadu. It requires a humid climate with high rainfall and temperature.

metadata.subject: Social Science
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Tea Cultivation in India in Grade 10 Social Science.

title: NCERT Grade 10 Social Science | Rubber Production in India
text:
Rubber Production in India

Key terms: rubber, equatorial crop, climate, rainfall

Rubber is an equatorial crop grown in India under special conditions in tropical and sub-tropical areas. It requires a moist and humid climate with high rainfall.

metadata.subject: Social Science
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Rubber Production in India in Grade 10 Social Science.

title: NCERT Grade 10 Social Science | Jute Production in India
text:
Jute Production in India

Key terms: jute, fibre, soils, flood plains, artefacts

Jute, known as the golden fibre, grows well on well-drained fertile soils in flood plains. It is used in making gunny bags, mats, ropes, and other artefacts.

metadata.subject: Social Science
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Jute Production in India in Grade 10 Social Science.

title: NCERT Grade 10 Social Science | Agricultural Reforms in India
text:
Agricultural Reforms in India

Key terms: agricultural reforms, collectivisation, consolidation, Green Revolution, White Revolution

Agricultural reforms in India include collectivisation, consolidation of holdings, cooperation, and abolition of zamindari. The Green Revolution and White Revolution were also initiated to improve Indian agriculture.

metadata.subject: Social Science
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to apply concepts related to Agricultural Reforms in India in Grade 10 Social Science.

title: NCERT Grade 10 Social Science | Cotton Production in India
text:
Cotton Production in India

Key terms: cotton, textile industry, Deccan plateau, temperature, rainfall

Cotton is one of the main raw materials for the cotton textile industry. It grows well in drier parts of the black cotton soil of the Deccan plateau and requires high temperature and light rainfall.

metadata.subject: Social Science
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Cotton Production in India in Grade 10 Social Science.

title: NCERT Grade 10 Social Science | Bhoodan-Gramdan Movement
text:
Bhoodan-Gramdan Movement

Key terms: Bhoodan-Gramdan, Vinoba Bhave, land distribution, Bloodless Revolution

The Bhoodan-Gramdan movement, initiated by Vinoba Bhave, aimed to distribute land from wealthy landowners to landless farmers. It is also known as the Bloodless Revolution.

metadata.subject: Social Science
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to analyze concepts related to Bhoodan-Gramdan Movement in Grade 10 Social Science.

title: NCERT Grade 10 Social Science | Government Schemes for Farmers
text:
Government Schemes for Farmers

Key terms: government schemes, farmers, Kisan Credit Card, crop insurance, minimum support price

The government of India has introduced various schemes for the benefit of farmers, such as Kisan Credit Card, Personal Accident Insurance Scheme, crop insurance, and minimum support price for crops.

metadata.subject: Social Science
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to evaluate concepts related to Government Schemes for Farmers in Grade 10 Social Science.

title: NCERT Grade 10 Social Science | Minerals in Daily Life
text:
Minerals in Daily Life

Key terms: minerals, daily life, buildings, food

Minerals are essential for our daily life, from tiny pins to tall buildings, and even in our food.

metadata.subject: Social Science
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to remember concepts related to Minerals in Daily Life in Grade 10 Social Science.

title: NCERT Grade 10 Social Science | Minerals in Toothpaste
text:
Minerals in Toothpaste

Key terms: toothpaste, minerals, cleaning, fluoride

Toothpaste contains minerals like silica, limestone, and fluoride for cleaning and whitening teeth.

metadata.subject: Social Science
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Minerals in Toothpaste in Grade 10 Social Science.

title: NCERT Grade 10 Social Science | Need for Minerals in Living Things
text:
Need for Minerals in Living Things

Key terms: minerals, life processes, food intake

Minerals are crucial for life processes, even though they make up only a small part of our food intake.

metadata.subject: Social Science
metadata.topic: Need for Minerals in Living Things
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Need for Minerals in Living Things in Grade 10 Social Science.

title: NCERT Grade 10 Social Science | Definition of Mineral
text:
Definition of Mineral

Key terms: mineral, homogenous, internal structure

A mineral is a naturally occurring, homogenous substance with a definable internal structure.

metadata.subject: Social Science
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to remember concepts related to Definition of Mineral in Grade 10 Social Science.

title: NCERT Grade 10 Social Science | Modes of Occurrence of Minerals
text:
Modes of Occurrence of Minerals

Key terms: minerals, occurrence, veins, beds, alluvial deposits

Minerals occur in various forms like veins, beds, alluvial deposits, and ocean waters.

metadata.subject: Social Science
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Modes of Occurrence of Minerals in Grade 10 Social Science.

title: NCERT Grade 10 Social Science | Ferrous Minerals in India
text:
Ferrous Minerals in India

Key terms: ferrous minerals, iron ore, industrial development, India

Ferrous minerals, like iron ore, are crucial for industrial development and are abundant in India.

metadata.subject: Social Science
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to apply concepts related to Ferrous Minerals in India in Grade 10 Social Science.

title: NCERT Grade 10 Social Science | Non-Ferrous Minerals in India
text:
Non-Ferrous Minerals in India

Key terms: non-ferrous minerals, copper, bauxite, industries

Non-ferrous minerals, like copper and bauxite, play vital roles in various industries but are not as abundant as ferrous minerals in India.

metadata.subject: Social Science
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to apply concepts related to Non-Ferrous Minerals in India in Grade 10 Social Science.

title: NCERT Grade 10 Social Science | Hazards of Mining
text:
Hazards of Mining

Key terms: mining, health issues, environmental degradation, water contamination, land pollution

Mining can lead to health issues for miners and environmental degradation, including water contamination and land pollution.

metadata.subject: Social Science
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to evaluate concepts related to Hazards of Mining in Grade 10 Social Science.

title: NCERT Grade 10 Social Science | Mining Hazards and Environmental Impact
text:
Mining Hazards and Environmental Impact

Key terms: mining hazards, water pollution, land degradation

Mining can cause roof collapses, fires, and water pollution. It also leads to land degradation and increased stream pollution due to waste dumping.

metadata.subject: Social Science
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Mining Hazards and Environmental Impact in Grade 10 Social Science.

title: NCERT Grade 10 Social Science | Aluminium Production and Usage
text:
Aluminium Production and Usage

Key terms: aluminium, discovery, usage

Aluminium, discovered in the 19th century, is lightweight and corrosion-resistant. It was initially used by royalty but later became common among beggars in Paris.

metadata.subject: Social Science
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to remember concepts related to Aluminium Production and Usage in Grade 10 Social Science.

title: NCERT Grade 10 Social Science | Mineral Conservation
text:
Mineral Conservation

Key terms: mineral resources, finite, non-renewable

Mineral resources are finite and non-renewable. They are formed over millions of years, and their extraction leads to increasing costs and decreasing quality.

metadata.subject: Social Science
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Mineral Conservation in Grade 10 Social Science.

title: NCERT Grade 10 Social Science | Energy Resources: Conventional vs Non-conventional
text:
Energy Resources: Conventional vs Non-conventional

Key terms: conventional energy, non-conventional energy

Energy resources can be classified as conventional (coal, petroleum, natural gas, electricity) and non-conventional (solar, wind, tidal, geothermal, biogas, atomic energy).

metadata.subject: Social Science
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Energy Resources: Conventional vs Non-conventional in Grade 10 Social Science.

title: NCERT Grade 10 Social Science | Coal: Formation and Uses
text:
Coal: Formation and Uses

Key terms: coal, formation, uses

Coal is formed from decaying plant material over millions of years. It is used for power generation, industry, and domestic needs. India is highly dependent on coal for its energy requirements.

metadata.subject: Social Science
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Coal: Formation and Uses in Grade 10 Social Science.

title: NCERT Grade 10 Social Science | Petroleum: Occurrence and Uses
text:
Petroleum: Occurrence and Uses

Key terms: petroleum, occurrence, uses

Petroleum occurs in porous rocks and is associated with anticlines and fault traps. It is used as fuel, lubricant, and raw material for manufacturing industries.

metadata.subject: Social Science
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Petroleum: Occurrence and Uses in Grade 10 Social Science.

title: NCERT Grade 10 Social Science | Natural Gas: Sources and Infrastructure
text:
Natural Gas: Sources and Infrastructure

Key terms: natural gas, sources, infrastructure

Natural gas is found with petroleum deposits and is used as fuel in various sectors. India's major gas reserves are found in Mumbai High and allied fields along the west coast.

metadata.subject: Social Science
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Natural Gas: Sources and Infrastructure in Grade 10 Social Science.

title: NCERT Grade 10 Social Science | Electricity Generation: Hydro and Thermal
text:
Electricity Generation: Hydro and Thermal

Key terms: electricity, hydroelectricity, thermal power

Electricity is generated by running water (hydroelectricity) or by burning fuels like coal, petroleum, and natural gas (thermal power).

metadata.subject: Social Science
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Electricity Generation: Hydro and Thermal in Grade 10 Social Science.

title: NCERT Grade 10 Social Science | Tidal Energy Utilization
text:
Tidal Energy Utilization

Key terms: tidal energy, turbine, Gulf of Khambhat, Gulf of Kuchchh, Gangetic delta

Tidal energy is harnessed using the flow of tides, with India's Gulf of Khambhat, Gulf of Kuchchh, and Gangetic delta providing ideal conditions. This energy is converted into electricity via turbines.

metadata.subject: Social Science
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Tidal Energy Utilization in Grade 10 Social Science.

title: NCERT Grade 10 Social Science | Geothermal Energy
text:
Geothermal Energy

Key terms: geothermal energy, Earth's heat, electricity generation

Geothermal energy is produced by utilizing the heat from the Earth's interior, with the Earth's temperature increasing with depth. This heat can be used to generate electricity.

metadata.subject: Social Science
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Geothermal Energy in Grade 10 Social Science.

title: NCERT Grade 10 Social Science | Mineral Formation in Igneous and Metamorphic Rocks
text:
Mineral Formation in Igneous and Metamorphic Rocks

Key terms: igneous rocks, metamorphic rocks, mineral formation

Minerals form in igneous rocks due to cooling and crystallization of magma, while in metamorphic rocks, they form due to heat and pressure changing the composition of existing rocks.

metadata.subject: Social Science
metadata.topic: Mineral Formation in Igneous and Metamorphic Rocks
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to apply concepts related to Mineral Formation in Igneous and Metamorphic Rocks in Grade 10 Social Science.

title: NCERT Grade 10 Social Science | Importance of Mineral Conservation
text:
